title: Meta Quest (VR)
description: A model for the Meta Quest VR headset. The headset has a mobile GPU and shared system memory, so we keep geometry and textures genuinely light.

availableExtensions.title: Safe optimizations
availableExtensions.description: Lossless cleanup: dedup materials/textures, remove unused data, weld identical vertices, drop degenerate and orphan geometry. Shape and materials are not changed.
availableExtensions.impact: Smaller file with no visible change.

availableExtensions.title: Meshopt compression
availableExtensions.description: Compresses geometry with Meshopt — smaller file that unpacks quickly on the GPU. A good default for the web.
availableExtensions.impact: Noticeably smaller geometry; fast decode in the browser.

availableExtensions.title: Join meshes
availableExtensions.description: Merges separate parts into one mesh — fewer draw calls. Structural: individual parts cannot be restored from the result.
availableExtensions.impact: Fewer draw calls; parts are merged (irreversible).

availableExtensions.title: GPU instancing
availableExtensions.description: Turns repeated meshes into copies drawn by the graphics card — fewer separate draws per frame. The app has to support this.
availableExtensions.impact: Fewer draw calls when the scene repeats meshes.

availableExtensions.title: Resample
availableExtensions.description: Removes redundant animation keyframes without changing the motion — smaller animation data.

availableExtensions.title: KTX2 compression
availableExtensions.description: Converts textures to a format the graphics card keeps compressed: up to ~80% less video memory — especially valuable for Quest with its shared memory. The app has to be able to open such textures — without that the model will not show.
availableExtensions.impact: The file may grow 5–10%, but texture video memory drops several-fold.

description.en: Repacks the model's textures so the file gets smaller — video memory stays the same. Textures already prepared for the graphics card are left alone. The app needs nothing extra to open this.
description.ru: Пережимает текстуры модели — файл становится меньше, видеопамяти нужно столько же. Текстуры, уже подготовленные для видеокарты, остаются как есть. Приложению ничего доустанавливать не нужно.

impact.en: Smaller download — the page opens faster. Video memory is unchanged: WebP is unpacked before it reaches the GPU.
impact.ru: Файл меньше — страница открывается быстрее. Видеопамять не меняется: WebP распаковывается до попадания в видеокарту.

availableExtensions.title: Draco compression
availableExtensions.description: Minimal file weight (often −50% on geometry). Decodes slower than Meshopt but is supported everywhere.
availableExtensions.impact: The file is noticeably lighter; decoding on open is slower.

availableExtensions.title: Quantization
availableExtensions.description: Quantization means writing vertex coordinates with fewer digits: instead of a long precise number, a shorter approximate one. The geometry gets lighter and the app needs nothing extra to open it — unlike Draco and Meshopt. Coordinates become slightly coarser: on a small detailed model that can show up as tiny gaps.
availableExtensions.impact: Geometry drops by a third to a half. The gain shows up in the file only when the weight is in the geometry, not in the textures.

availableExtensions.title: Remove vertex colors
availableExtensions.description: Removes painted vertex colors. Enable only if vertex colors are not visible in the model (white channels are removed without this option too).
availableExtensions.impact: Saves 5–20% of size if colors exist; may change the look if they were used.

notes: triangles 100000 — a conservative budget for a single object: Meta's recommendations for Quest allow 350–500k triangles for the whole frame, so we leave headroom for the environment and other objects.
drawCalls 50 — Meta's recommendation for Quest: 50–100 draw calls per frame; for a single object we take the lower bound.
textureMaxSize 1024 — Meta's recommendation: on the headset's mobile GPU keep textures small (1K), 2K only for large surfaces.
vramMB 64 — guideline: Quest shares memory with the system, so saving video memory is critical for stable FPS.
fileMB 8 — guideline: less data loads into the headset's memory.
noKtx true — v0.0.8: baseline plan without KTX2 (textures stay PNG/WebP); KTX2 is an extension enabled by explicit user choice.
texMode mixed — if the user enables the ktx2 extension: the headset's mobile GPU needs savings, color textures in the lightest format.
extension id = core feature name: web-interface passes the selected ids to optimizeFile as advancedFeatures; the opts field is the equivalent for the legacy path.
